name: Card
signature: Card(variant: default|interactive|panel|ghost = default, rows: false|true = false, state: default|hover|focus = default, header: boolean = true, title: text, body: text, footer: boolean = false) slots: content, actions
description: Container (ui/card.tsx, cva Ej). variant default (card ground, 8px radius, card-hairline + shadow-card), interactive (hover card-hover, clickable), panel (12px radius, panel ground; settings/overview panes), ghost. Header/footer use 0.5px border-1 rules with px16 py12; content p16. rows=true divides children with 0.5px border-1.
usage: <doop-use component="Card" variant="default" rows="false" state="default" title="…"><template slot="content">…</template><template slot="actions">…</template></doop-use>
template:
Card title
Card content sits on a 16px inset.
